children: On September 2, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5450(a)(2), which requires at least 400 total holders. The notice has no immediate effect; the company must submit a plan by October 19, 2026, and, if accepted, may receive up to 180 days from the notice to regain compliance.
